title: Say Misyon ed Kadaanan a Syudad
intro: Sakey a dabok a baley nensaman, saray totoo to so ag-inmabobon, tan sakey a unor a pasakbay ya ag-inimano. Natan, onloob kayo ed betang na saramay imbaki nen Allah pian mangiter na mensahe ed saray totoon masebeg. Sakey ya istorya na ag-inmabobon, sakey a nikadkaduman boses na pananisia, tan sakey a sampot a tinatakan na makapasinagem a ganggan. Siopay mansasalita panamegley na sarayan pakapatnagan?
clues: Imbaki kami nen Allah ed sakey a baley ya saray totoo to et inmarawi ed katuaan
Duara ed sikami so inmuna, insan say komatlo so akibiang pian pabiskegen so misyon mi
Impulisay kami na saray taga baley, ya inkuan dan singa kami labat totoo
Sakey a kamarerwa a nanlapud sankaarawian a sampot na syudad so binmatik a mangibaga ed saray totoo ya ontumbok ira ed sikami
Akikasi kamid sikara, balet pinaawet day puso ra tan sinmumpa rad sikami
Diad sakey a makapasinagem ya eyag manlapud katawenan, say interon syudad tayo so nareen

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Saray Mensahero na Baley ed Surah Ya-Sin
Saray Hawwariyyun (Saray babangatan nen Isa)
Saray Managsalamangka ed Korte nen Faraon
Saray Kaiba ed Sabaton
Saray Totoo na Elepante
identity.answer: Saray Mensahero na Baley ed Surah Ya-Sin

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Impulisay tan tinawag ya matila na saray taga baley
Pinoolan a mabilay ed baleg a mandarlang ya apoy
Inakmon na baleg a sira ed aralem a dayat
Napilitan ya mankimey ed pangipaalagey na atagey a lusek
Pinairap ed sakey a kanal na mansasnit ya apoy
trial.answer: Impulisay tan tinawag ya matila na saray taga baley

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Say kadaanan a baley (al-Qaryah)
Sakey a baleg a manliob a hurnoan
Say eges na baleg a sira
Say atagey a lusek ya onsabi ed tawen
Say sagradon Abung (Kaaba)

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Say baley et aderal lapud sakey a makapasinagem ya eyag (Sayha)
Say managpairap tan say armada to so nalner ed naapag a dayat
Saray totoo et nagmaliw ya ayep tan unggoy
Say uran na bato a nanlapud tawen so aneral ed syudad
Sakey a maksil a delap so angiyanor ed interon komunidad
outcome.answer: Say baley et aderal lapud sakey a makapasinagem ya eyag (Sayha)

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
